blocks.content: TabPFN-3.5 attained an ROC-AUC of 0.885 (95% CI: 0.840–0.930), outperforming the majority baseline (0.500) by +0.385. Accuracy reached 85.7% vs 71.4% baseline. Tenure is the strongest predictor of customer churn.
